_note: Fare rule sets, assigned to terminals by fareRuleId. 'trikefair_buenavista' is the original TRIKEFAIR matrix and reads its rates from rules.json unchanged. 'demo_sample' uses the same rate structure, at the New Poblacion TODA fare card's level, for terminals with no ordinance on file and is labelled DEMO / SAMPLE RATE everywhere it appears. Neither is an official Guimaras fare.

fareRules.label: PANAW provisional matrix

fareRules.label: DEMO / SAMPLE RATE
fareRules.statusNote: No ordinance on file for this terminal. Sample values for demonstration only, set to the level of the New Poblacion TODA fare card (P25 regular per passenger; special trip P70 for the first 2 km plus P20 per km), the only local fare data PANAW has.
fareRules.ordinance: DEMO / SAMPLE RATE — no ordinance on file

fareRules.label: New Poblacion TODA fare card
fareRules.statusNote: Regular hire: P25 flat per passenger (P20 student/senior/PWD), as printed on the card. Special trip: P70 for the first 2 km plus P20 per km, fitted to the card's 35 barangay prices by OSRM road distance (R2 0.67, average gap P24). The card price is shown next to each listed barangay.

fareRules.ordinance: TODA fare card (association rate; LGU ordinance number to verify)
